name: core_software_eval
description: Small evaluation suite covering software engineering reasoning and API reliability concepts.

cases.prompt: Why is idempotency important for a payment API?
cases.reference_answer: Idempotency prevents the same payment request from creating duplicate transactions when clients retry after timeouts or network failures.

cases.prompt: What does a Kafka consumer offset represent?
cases.reference_answer: A consumer offset records the position of a consumer in a Kafka partition so processing can resume from a known point.
